description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Steering Knuckle Rebuild Kit plus the Complete Front Axle Rebuild Kit.
Includes the Knuckle Bearings PLUS the Axle Bearings.
Get everything you need to completely Rebuild ONE SIDE OF the front-end.
Does RIGHT or LEFT Side!
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Front Axle Inner Bearing
Qty 1 – Front Axle Outer Bearing
Qty 1 – Front Axles Inner Oil Seal
Qty 1 – Front Axles Outer Oil Seal
Qty 2 – Steering Knuckle Bearings
Qty 1 – Shims for King Pin
Qty 1 – Steering Knuckle Oil Seal
Qty 1 – Steering Knuckle Felt
Qty 2 – Steering Knuckle Felt Retainer Plates
Qty 2 – Steering Knuckle Oil Seal Cover Plates
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
